name: Agra
summary: Home of the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri; usually visited as a day trip from Delhi.
season_note: October to March for cool weather; fog can block sunrise views in winter. April to June is extremely hot.
entry_note: Indian visa is required for Bangladeshi passport holders (apply via the Indian Visa Application Centre; category as currently offered). Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Delhi (then train/cab to Agra) (Biman, US-Bangla, IndiGo, Air India; often via Kolkata)
reach.note: Fly to Delhi then 3.5 hours by car or Gatimaan Express.

reach.how: Delhi to Agra by Gatimaan Express or Shatabdi

local.note: For Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri.

attractions.name: Taj Mahal
attractions.what: The white-marble mausoleum built by Shah Jahan, one of the world's wonders.
attractions.tip: Closed on Fridays; sunrise is best. Foreigner ticket is much higher than locals.

attractions.name: Agra Fort
attractions.what: A UNESCO red-sandstone fort with palaces and views of the Taj.
attractions.tip: Allow two hours; combine with Taj on the same day.

attractions.name: Fatehpur Sikri
attractions.tip: Hire a licensed guide; touts are aggressive.

attractions.name: Mehtab Bagh
attractions.what: Garden across the river with Taj view at sunset.

attractions.name: Itimad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj)
attractions.what: A delicate marble tomb with inlay work.

attractions.name: Akbar's Tomb, Sikandra
attractions.what: A large garden tomb of Emperor Akbar.
attractions.tip: Deer and monkeys roam; hold your belongings.

attractions.name: Kinari Bazaar
attractions.what: Market for marble inlay, leather and sweets.

rules: Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays.
Security bans food, tripods and large bags at the Taj.
